essence: The foremost practitioner should sprinkle either twenty-one times or another specified number of times.
Afterwards, the practitioner should put on two suitable garments.
After placing sacred ash on the forehead as before, the practitioner should remember the venerable guru.
After that, one should repeat the goddess gāyatrī according to one's ability.
One should offer libation with the deity tīrtha using the mantra ending in the fourth case and svāhā.
